title: Italian Treasures
blurb: Rome, Lucca, Florence, Venice and Assisi in ten nights, with a boat along the Cinque Terre and a wine tasting in Chianti.
pace: Full days, two nights in most places, and a few long drives
inclusions:
Ten nights in first-class hotels
Ten breakfasts and four dinners, including welcome and farewell dinners
Tour director throughout
Guided walks in Rome, Florence, Venice and Assisi
Castel Sant’Angelo with a local guide
Boat along the Cinque Terre coast, weather permitting, and the train back from Monterosso
Stop at the Leaning Tower in Pisa
Chianti wine tasting with local food at a farmhouse
Private boat ride in Venice and a glassblowing demonstration
A choice of excursion in Florence: the Pitti Palace with an aperitivo, or a food walk
erics_note:
This is the Globus tour I suggest for a first trip to Italy when Rome, Florence and Venice on their own feel too narrow. It adds two nights in Lucca for the Cinque Terre and Pisa, a wine tasting in Chianti, and a night in Assisi on the way back to Rome. Most stops are two nights, so you unpack less often than the route suggests.

The days are full, and Rome to Lucca and Venice to Assisi are long drives. In Venice the hotel is in Sant’Elena, a quiet residential corner a vaporetto ride from St Mark’s. If you would rather see fewer places and stay longer in each, ask me about a custom journey instead.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Rome
itinerary.text: Meet your tour director and the group at 5 pm for a welcome dinner at a local restaurant.

itinerary.title: St Peter’s and the Forum
itinerary.text: A guided walk through St Peter’s Square, then the Roman Forum. The afternoon and evening are free.

itinerary.title: Rome to Lucca
itinerary.text: North by coach through Umbria and Tuscany to walled Lucca, with an orientation walk and free time in the old centre.

itinerary.title: Cinque Terre and Pisa
itinerary.text: A boat from La Spezia along the Cinque Terre coast to Monterosso, weather permitting, then free time and the train back. On the way to Lucca, a stop at the Leaning Tower in Pisa. Dinner is included.

itinerary.title: San Gimignano and Chianti
itinerary.text: An orientation walk and free time in San Gimignano, then a wine tasting with local food at a Chianti farmhouse before Florence.

itinerary.title: Florence
itinerary.text: A guided walk past the cathedral, Giotto’s bell tower, the Baptistery doors and Piazza della Signoria. Then your choice of included excursion: the Pitti Palace with an aperitivo, or a food walk with a glass from a wine window. The evening is free.

itinerary.title: Verona, then Venice
itinerary.text: A walk through Piazza delle Erbe and Piazza Bra, beside the Roman Arena, then on to Venice by private boat.

itinerary.title: Venice
itinerary.text: A guided walk in St Mark’s Square and a visit to the Doge’s Palace and the Bridge of Sighs, then a glassblowing demonstration. The afternoon and evening are free.

itinerary.title: Venice to Assisi
itinerary.text: Across the Apennines to Assisi for a guided walk and the Basilicas of St Clare and St Francis. Dinner is included.

itinerary.title: Orvieto and back to Rome
itinerary.text: An orientation walk to Orvieto’s cathedral with free time, then Castel Sant’Angelo with a local guide in Rome. Farewell dinner.
